k31-luna-behind-door.observed_description: In a bright hallway a white door stands half open; Luna's head and one white paw peek out from behind its edge at floor height; nothing is in front of the door.
k31-luna-behind-door.note: Usable: behind the door reads at 360 px and in the 4:5 crop; her head is small but whole.

k32-luna-front-door.observed_description: Luna sits on a wooden hallway floor in front of a closed white door, fully visible, looking at the camera.
k32-luna-front-door.note: Usable: in front of the door reads at 180 px.
